summary: A row of stars showing a rating out of max (5 by default): lit stars in the accent colour, a half star for a .5, the rest outlined; tapping the i-th star sets the value to i (then sends `onRate` and runs any `onClick` actions). Each star is announced "N stars" and the row its label and current rating

value.doc: The rating, 0..max, in half steps or finer (3.5 shows three stars and a half). Bind a document variable ("@rating") to preset it and read it back after a tap; a number gives the call its own variable starting there

max.doc: Number of stars (a literal: the stars are generated when the document is built)

size.doc: Star size in dp (16 for an inline score, 32 to 40 for a review form). Tappable stars under 48 dp get transparent padding to a 48 dp touch target each (the star keeps its size; the gap between stars grows to the padding)

color.doc: Lit stars and the half star (amber by default); in mono they are onSurface

emptyColor.doc: The outline of an empty star; in mono it is outline

interactive.doc: Tapping star i sets value to i (whole stars). false shows a rating without changing it (a review's score)

label.doc: Accessibility label of the row; the row also announces the bound value at run time as its state ("Rating, 3 of 5 stars", "Not rated" at 0), and each tappable star reads "N stars"

onClick.doc: Extra actions run on every star tap after the value is set and after onRate. To tell the host the new rating with one action from every star: [{"type": "hostNamedAction", "name": "rate", "value": "@rating", "valueType": "float"}] with value bound to "@rating" (the action reads the variable when it runs, so it carries the star just tapped; json2rc declares a name used by several actions once). Omitted: a tap only sets `value`; ignored when interactive is false

onRate.doc: Host action name sent on every star tap with the NEW rating: {"onRate": "rate"} adds {"type": "hostNamedAction", "name": "rate", "value": "@<value's variable>", "valueType": "float"} after the value is set (a json2rc extension: not byte-identical with the reference JSON parser). Ignored when interactive is false

pitfalls: Each star is one canvas holding three Material Symbols paths (star outlined, star_half, star filled) in the empty colour and the accent, switched with paint alpha step(value - i, 0.25) and step(value - i, 0.75): below .25 over the star's index it is empty, from .25 a half, from .75 full. The three paths are stored once per document however many ratings it holds
The stars are generated when the document is built ($each over max), so max must be a literal; the value is a variable and may change at run time

A tap sets whole stars only (the i-th star sets i); a half star comes from the value a host writes (3.5). Tapping the lit count again does not clear it: give a reset of your own when 0 must be reachable by touch

The tap writes a literal with valueFloatChange, not valueFloatExpressionChange: both the Java parser and json2rc read a literal number in the latter's value as a float id (Java writes id 0, json2rc the float's low bits), so a literal there sets nothing
Mono draws lit stars in onSurface and empty ones in the outline grey whatever colours the call passes, so the state stays readable on a 1-bit display

Accessibility: each tappable star is labelled "1 star", "2 stars"... (a textMerge of a literal textFromFloat and " stars"; the first a plain text); the row carries the label (contentDescription) and the rating as its state (stateDescription): "3 of 5 stars", "4.5 of 5 stars", "Not rated" at 0. The state is cut by textSubtext from "Not rated" + whole part + ".5" (when fract(value) > .25) + " of max stars", in the global section of a 0-size canvas in a box before the row (the parsers bind the name in document order), so it follows a bound variable at run time. About 300 B for a first call (later calls share the texts) plus about 45 B per tappable star; the named text ops keep it from compiling to a pattern
The spoken half follows fract(value) > .25 while the drawn star rounds at .25/.75 too, but a 4.8 is spoken "4.5" while five stars are lit: hosts should write whole or half values

Tappable stars under 48 dp sit in a 48 dp touch target each (padding (48 - size) / 2 inside the clickable canvas) with no gap between targets, so a 24 dp row is 240 dp wide; read-only stars keep size and the size / 12 gap

onRate and onClick actions run after the star's valueFloatChange: a hostNamedAction carrying "@rating" (valueType float) sends the star just tapped. Write ONE action name for all stars (onRate, or one onClick hostNamedAction): json2rc declares the shared name once; the reference JSON parser does not support value-carrying actions
